subject: Prevent Javascript Embedding to Reduce File Size

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Prevent Javascript Embedding to Reduce File Size
parts:
Hi, 

I've been using Knitr to create a report file from a database-like file. I can process things fine, but there is a massive amount of embedded Javascript at the top of my file. If I delete it, much of the clean formatting goes away, but at the same time it adds over 500 kb to the filesize. I am emailing this report to many people and I would like it to be a small as possible. 

What and where are the options to prevent embedding of these scripts? Is there a way to keep the formatting without such a heavy overhead? 

I don't need embedding of the original data or anything like that. The output is simple HTML with a little bit of custom CSS. I assume the nice(r) formatting comes from Bootstrap? 

Thanks, 

Brandon

messages.author: e7658bf6e6befd70
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Prevent Javascript Embedding to Reduce File Size
parts:
You can get rid of the giant HTML header by setting the `theme` option
to null, which means you lose the default libraries Bootstrap and
jQuery, etc that make your report pretty. You can certainly design
your own stylesheets. Please see
http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/html_document_format.html

There is a lightweight output format called html_vignette in
rmarkdown: http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/package_vignette_format.html
An example of what it looks like:
http://cran.rstudio.com/web/packages/dplyr/vignettes/data_frames.html
I have a tweaked version in knitr:::html_vignette, which looks like
this http://cran.rstudio.com/web/packages/knitr/vignettes/knitr-intro.html

Regards,
Yihui
--

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Prevent Javascript Embedding to Reduce File Size
parts:
Yihui, 

Thanks for the pointer. I set my header to the following and it's now much lighter. I'll set the fonts myself and roll from here. 

output:
  html_document:
    mathjax: null
    theme: null
    highlight: null

Thanks, 
B
